dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: ...I'm serious! You should let me come with you!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Or if not me, then at least find some mercenaries to join you.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: A large group moves too slowly. Speed is what we need to catch a fugitive like him.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: That's enough. Proceed as planned. We have to get him on the first try.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Hmm? Nothing major. A scholar made a prohibited device and fled the Akademiya with it. We're already in pursuit.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: We've decided to act discreetly to avoid alarming the general public.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like you're going alone, then?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Affirmative. The plan is all set. Other matra will prepare the trap, and I will go alone and drive him into it.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: He's cunning. He's already outwitted multiple matra tracking him, and some... sustained significant injuries.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: But he won't escape this time.

choices.text: I know you won't fail, Cyno.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Mm. Don't worry, I'm just scaring a cowardly little jackal. It'll jump into the trap on its own.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: If it resists, then... the sands will claim it.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: ...It's fine — I handle cases like this all the time. There won't be any surprises.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Sorry, inspiration eludes me for now.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I'll be sure to tell you a good one once I get back.

choices.text: Can't say I'm used to this side of you yet...
